faceDesign.name: 분이벌레
faceDesign.why: 작은 애벌레의 둥근 마디를 둥근 볼과 작은 눈으로 해석한다.
faceDesign.adjusted: 다른 종과 넷 이상 겹쳐 원작 단서의 다음 후보로 옮김 — 눈썹 가늘고 완만한 곡선 → 길고 바깥 아치가 선명한 [머리] 헤어스타일 상한(8%·보브 4%)에 닿아 단정한 보브컷 → 층을 살린 레이어드

hair_cues: ‘three white hairs’(원작의 머리칼) → 헤어스타일 층을 살린 레이어드

prompt:
INPUT: attach this character's light-form card image (the closed state). If a second image fits, add her approved light-form image for the face.

SOURCE: Scatterbug (분이벌레), bug type.

STYLE: Premium glossy anime-mecha promotional key art with clean linework, vivid controlled color, dimensional 2.5D shading and dense but organized hard-surface detail. Match the face and armor at the same polished rendering intensity.

OUTPUT: the OPENED (overdrive) state of the attached image. Keep its camera, pose, framing, subject scale, face, hair, body and every armor piece exactly. Change only this: the slim plates lift away from their seams on small hinges, revealing the inner frame, and a lime-green glow with shimmering wing-like light shows through the gaps, lighting the undersides of the opened plates; her eyes keep their color with only a glint of that light, and her expression tightens with the strain. No new armor, no new helmet, no weapon. The pair must read as the same picture before and after she opens up.

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no creature beside her, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.

HANDS: keep both hands exactly as in the attached image — one thumb and four fingers each on the correct side, clearly separated, never merged, doubled, extra or mirrored; the glow and spray stay off the fingers.
